messages:
asha: hi all, i'm asha (product analytics) day 1. trying to provision a test GCE instance in europe-west4 but the project isn't linked to billing and quotas show 0 GPUs. who owns linking sandboxes to the billing account and requesting regional quotas?

marta: welcome @asha! tag @finance for billing links and @dev-ops for quota/support. quick q: which project id and what instance type (n1-standard, A100, etc)?

asha: project id `prj-analytics-sbx-eu`. need a small gpu for local perf tests: n1-standard-4 + 1 x nvidia-t4 in europe-west4. console says "quota limit reached" and in Billing it shows "No billing account linked".

finance: hey @asha, billing link is done by finance but requires a signed cost center and environment approval. please open a ticket in FINANCE with project id, business justification (test/dev), and owner's manager approval. We also need the billing account id to attach (ask dev-ops if unsure).

dev-ops: for quota, we request via GCP quota console but only after billing is attached. We'll also check if europe-west4 has project-level GPU restrictions. If you want immediate local testing, you can use our shared dev-gpu pool in us-central1 (ephemeral) — want me to provision a slot?

asha: thanks. opened FIN-4420 with rationale and manager cc'd. also pasted the screenshot of quota and billing page.

cloudinfra-bot: FIN-4420 created and assigned to finance, priority: normal. Note: linking will apply org-level billing restrictions. Expected turnaround 1-3 business days.

marta: once finance links billing, dev-ops can request the regional quota increase. dev-ops will need the exact sku: `GPUS_TESLA_T4` and quota name `GPUS_ALL_REGIONS` or `GPUS_IN_REGION`. Also include expected sustained usage (e.g., 1 GPU x 8 hours/day) to expedite.

dev-ops: okay noted. @asha please add the SKU and expected usage in FIN-4420. If the project is enrolled in our cost-controls policy we may need manager approval for sustained quotas.

asha: updated FIN-4420 with SKU GPUS_TESLA_T4 and "1 GPU for perf smoke tests, ~8 hours/day, < $200/month estimate". also added the project owner and billing contact: `oncall-cloud@redwood.com`

finance: saw the update, starting billing link checks. FYI if project needs cross-org billing we may need an invoice approval from EE team — will update in the ticket.

dev-ops: finance flagged the payer as `PA-210`. I'm submitting the quota request now after billing completes. If quotas are tight in europe-west4 we can fallback to europe-west3 or allocate the shared dev slot in us-central1.

asha: appreciate it. one more Q: do I need any specific IAM roles to view quota pages or the billing console once linked?

marta: yes: for billing console you need `roles/billing.viewer` on the billing account. For project quota view you need `roles/viewer` on the project; for requesting quota increases we typically add you to `roles/editor` temporarily or submit on your behalf. Finance will add billing viewer if requested.

finance: pls include in FIN-4420 if you'd like billing.viewer. otherwise we'll grant minimal access to complete the link.

asha: will request billing.viewer. thanks all :pray:
